data.title: China Opens Its Own Case to Confiscate 61,896 Bitcoin Held by UK Authorities
data.description: A Tianjin court opened a six-month notice period in prosecutors’ bid to forfeit Qian Zhimin’s bitcoin, a day after London’s High Court held that Chinese law applies to whether victims have rights in the coins.
